mapper.select: SELECT id, book_key, title, author, translator, publisher, category, summary, cover_url, tag_list, word_count, chapter_count, read_count, rating, status, sort_order, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM book WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY published_at DESC, sort_order ASC, updated_at DESC

SELECT id, book_key, title, author, translator, publisher, category, summary, cover_url, tag_list, word_count, chapter_count, read_count, rating, status, sort_order, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM book WHERE book_key = #{bookKey} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, chapter_key, book_key, chapter_no, title, subtitle, content_html, word_count, is_free, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM book_chapter WHERE book_key = #{bookKey} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, chapter_no ASC, id ASC
